verdict.rationale: VLP's own pages describe startup-focused services such as entity formation, seed financings and senior-attorney staffing. None of the evidence shows a published startup package with deferred fees, fixed-fee formation, or a named program with stated terms. Service descriptions without fee terms do not meet this fee-transparency story.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm publishes a startup package — deferred fees, fixed-fee formation, or a named program with stated terms — on its own pages
